biochemLabs.title: Labs · R&D and testing
biochemLabs.subtitle: The testing lab checks every batch and finished lot against the approved limits; the R&D lab develops formulas until they are approved

s.title: Testing lab · samples
s.emptyBody: Samples arrive when production sends the bulk sample and the finished-lot sample.

result.title: Result for {{no}}
result.noRight: You can see the sample but not record results. Ask Admin for the QC test right.
result.noSpec: No QC limits on the approved formula for this stage; the result is recorded without a limit check.
result.rule: Limits come from the approved formula. A pass outside them is refused. The person who made or packed the batch can't release it; each result is saved with your name, the time and the instrument.

rules.title: Lab rules
rules.sampled: Every batch is sampled at bulk and at the finished lot; the bulk weight is recorded with the bulk sample.
rules.independent: Testing is independent: the maker or packer of a batch can't release it.
rules.calibrated: Calibrated instruments only: one past its date can't be picked for a result.
rules.retention: One retention sample per finished lot, kept for the period QC sets.

r.title: R&D trials
r.emptyBody: Start a trial for a new formula; stability checks are planned and recorded here.
